description: Returns the configuration of every monitor, or of those matching the filters (keywords, type, active, maintenance, tags, parent group). Use it to find monitor IDs or compare settings; for current UP/DOWN status use getMonitorSummary instead. Type-specific fields such as url, hostname and port are returned only with includeTypeSpecificFields.

active.description: Filter by active status. true=only active monitors, false=only inactive monitors.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***". Off by default: this output is persisted in conversation transcripts and logs. Can also be enabled globally with UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS=true.

includeTypeSpecificFields.description: Include type-specific fields (url, hostname, port, etc.) in addition to common fields. Default: false. When false, only returns MonitorBase fields plus uptime/avgPing.

keywords.description: Space-separated keywords to filter monitors by pathName (case-insensitive fuzzy match). All keywords must match for a monitor to be included.

maintenance.description: Filter by maintenance status. true=only monitors in maintenance, false=only monitors not in maintenance.

parentId.description: Filter to the DIRECT children of this group monitor. Pass null for top-level monitors (those with no parent). Not recursive — use the group's own childrenIDs to walk deeper.

tags.description: Filter by tag name and optional value. Comma-separated for multiple tags. Format: "tagName" or "tagName=value". Monitor must have all specified tags. Case-insensitive. Examples: "production", "env=staging", "production,region=us-east"

type.description: Filter by monitor type(s). Comma-separated for multiple types. Use listMonitorTypes tool to see all available types.

name: listMonitors

type.description: A single comparison, or a group of nested conditions

monitors.description: Array of monitor objects with common fields plus uptime/avgPing. May include type-specific fields when includeTypeSpecificFields is true. Credentials (pushToken, basic_auth_pass, bearer_token, headers, ...) read "***" unless includeSecrets is set.

interval.description: Check interval in seconds (min 1, no upper bound)

maxretries.description: Max retries before marking as down

type.description: Monitor type. Use listMonitorTypes for the valid values.

title: List Monitors
